title: Mesh skeleton extraction via TEASAR (/mesh/skeleton)
description: POST /mesh/skeleton extracts skeletal structure from reference OBJ via voxelized TEASAR: voxelize interior, compute distance-from-boundary field, extract branches via penalized Dijkstra with iterative invalidation. Returns branches, joint positions+radii, branch points, directions, and segment lengths.
definition-of-done: Endpoint returns JSON with branches (joints, radii, directions, lengths), branch points, and tree structure. Hand.obj produces 5-6 branches with correct topology.
testing-plan: Run on Hand.obj at resolution=128 — expect 5-6 branches. Verify root near palm center, branch points at finger junctions, radii thinner at tips.
